title: Task
description: A pm-dispatch task — runtime projection of a BACKLOG.md row. Markdown stays primary; this schema documents the row shape and the lifecycle the row's status column encodes.

id.description: Ticket id. Pattern matches pm/schema.md grammar (e.g. CC-229, JS-106).

epic.description: Maps to BACKLOG row epic column. Valid values enforced by pm/scripts/validate.sh::valid_epic — kept here as a free string in M1; pmctl validate may narrow in M2.

area.description: Maps to BACKLOG row area column. Valid values enforced by pm/scripts/validate.sh::valid_area_token.
